verdict.rationale: Jina Reader's core function is converting URLs to LLM-friendly markdown output, with strong first-party documentation confirming clean markdown as the default response format, plus configurable output modes (frontmatter, JSON schema extraction, chunking) that all build on the markdown pipeline. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of markdown quality/cleanliness beyond vendor docs (community evidence cited only touches auth/availability issues, not output format fidelity).
